t:
Maa7_Elph writes: Nedjeses, have you heard that someone's been peddling that theory about "good Tep" and "bad Nefer Ur" again? It's just djut! How can anyone believe in that? They tell they got some "convicing proof", but it's just creepy!

Amon_9k writes: Are you for real?! Cringe! It's like saying that the Master Goblin is the real biggest villain of this entire story! I don’t understand for the life of me how anyone can subscribe to that! Have the ickers really lost their marbles completely?

Cleo2p writes: Totally agreed! That's just beyond the pale! How can anyone twist the facts like that?! These theories are plainly absurd! Everyone's gotta hear the truth, not this fegen!

Sph1nx writes: Right, I don't know who even came up with that, but that someone really has lost it! Maybe they just want to stir some hype around this? But it's, like, a total ahku! I wish they'd be memeing about cats instead!

Hath0r writes: Come on, nekhens! If it all had been that easy, the world would've toppled over by now! But no, we're still discussing that rigmarole! Let them keep stewing in their conspiracy theories while we're enjoying life!

R4_Light writes: You heard the fresh cringey news?! Some sort of sado-masochistic cult has attacked the Khadmon mansion! And what, pray tell, is Shereda doing? She's out to save them, imagine that!

Bastet_8 writes: What kind of nonsense is that?! Shereda, alone against a whole cult? Is she out of her mind or what?! Though if there's anyone capable of routing them, it's her! I hope she's got a whip and a couple of zombies for kicks!

H0r_Vet writes: Oh come on, it's just djut! Shereda, don't you get that these masochists might catch you and start torturing you?! If I were her, I would've been long gone as far as I could from this hahrtah, but she seems to be enjoying it!

7eb_Sun writes: Nekhens, did you just see Shereda tear 'em all up? I'm just in awe of her skills! How is she doing that, anyway?! This is just pure fun!

Hmdi writes: Oh, yeah! Shereda is just da bombshell! She's so gloomy, but so charismatic at the same time! I would've done just about anything for her sake! And her style?

O5iris1 writes: Agreed 100%! Shereda is just a star girl! She's so unpredictable that her every move is like a new cinema! I would've loved for her to be my girlfriend so we could be doing all sort of rad things together!

Anu8is5 writes: Right, I'm so excited too! Shereda's not just a ketet, she's a whole great story! It's like she's from another dimension where all the usual ickers are boring nerds! And she's just tearing up the rules while being cool about it!

R4_Mystery writes: Hah, right! Shereda is the real queen of darkness! Her witty phrases are sharp enough to cut vegetables with them! If only she were my classmate, everyone would've gone crazy witnessing her coolness!

Anu8is writes: Listen, I can't understand how can a man be a khemetean! I mean, they love other men! That's just gross, nedjeses!

H0rus_Hwk writes: Oh, come on, nedjes, what are you on about? Khemeteans are just a different kind of culture, and they have the right to be who they are! Don't you force the bounds on ickers, everyone's got the right to express oneself! Even if it's through hind quarters. So get out with your toxic attitude!

Bast3t7 writes: But that's not normal! We all live with some kind of stereotypes in mind, but now they're all turned around! How can it be? I don't want our nedjeses to become some kind of wussy khemeteans, that'd be so gross!

S3t_Power writes: Maybe you're just envious since they have more courage than you do! Khemeteans are not about weakness, but about self-confidence!

Hatsh3ps2 writes: Hey, nedjeses, do you really think that khasayites are a okay? It's, like, totally unsound! They just sell themselves as if the body is an object that can be auctioned!

N4t_Shad writes: Oh, come on, nedjes, don't be envious! To each his own. If someone want to be doing that, fine, so long as no one get judgemental. Life is short, and one has to earn cash somehow!

T0t_Star writes: But that's just dumb! They risk their health and very lives for the sake of drachmas. It's not life, it's just survival! How can you support that?

Maa7_Soul writes: Oh, come on now! Everyone chooses their own path. Better be a hustler than work for a khud for a couple of drachmas!

Amon_8kg writes: Nekhens, do you know just what's going on at the Khadmons' house? Looks like they're really breeding zombies there! I've chanced into their basement once, and it's so creepy there that I nearly lost my mind! It's like they study the dead and reanimate them, and it's like fun pastime for them!

Cleo2p6 writes: Now that's sick... are you for real?! It's like, totally sebu! Maybe they're out to create their own zombie farm! How can they live like this? If I were them, I would've called the madhouse to this zombie laboratory!

P4_Ra writes: Oh, come on, stop the giggles! Do you think they're just doing it for the lolz? It's no laughing matter, it's real creepy! I wouldn't have even set foot in their house - what if they decide to spread me on the surgical table, too?

Sph1nx4 writes: Right, that's just rough! It's like they want to breed that zombie plague right in their own basement! We gotta get out of that area and warn all the neighbors - what if they set their zombies on us, too?

Khatkh0r8 writes: Haha, they're really not right in the heads! Why'd they need these zombies? If they want to find friends, they'd better find real people, not these undead! I would've never thought they're out for something like that - it's just djut!

7eb_Life writes: Nekhens, do you know the Khadmons are really having some kind of issue with their treasury? I've heard they got so much gold there that it'd be enough for a lifetime! But really, getting there would be one heck of a trial! Even Marianna Lopatina would want to steer clear of the kind of traps they got there!

Nzb_Mystery writes: No way, is that true?! I would've tried to get inside before long, but these traps are just a sebu! They say there are arrows, and spike pits, and whatnot! Nah, I'd rather chill out and have a snack than crawl into that kind of plague storm!

Api5_Power writes: Haha, you're right! Sure, they're doing everything to stop anyone from getting to their riches! But I just don't get it, why do they need all of that stuff? They could just start a museum and get cash from visitors instead of walling everyone off with traps!

Hepri_7k writes: Right, this is just djut! If only I knew how to get in there, I would've taken a couple friends along with me on a zombie expedition! But I'm not keen on traps, thank you very much! I'm not ready for that kind of fun - I'd rather play games instead!

Noot_9jdn writes: Agreed 100%! These Khadmons are really creepy! Why do they need all that cash - they live like zombies themselves! They'd rather share some of it with ickers instead of hiding their lucre behind traps and whatnot!

3nubis9 writes: Nedjeses, you're not gonna believe what I saw yesterday! Nomarkh Miu, that same one from the "Library", was walking along the street with a huge black cat! And that cat was really huge - I thought it was a mini lion of sorts, not a cat! Honest, I very nearly just bolted when it looked at me!

Osiris_4k writes: Creepy! I would've bolted, all right! That cat must've been not a cat at all, but some sort of real demon! I've heard she got some magic dealings with it, so if it can talk, I would be totally believing that!

Nefert2a writes: Haha, that's just djut! I would've run away from that cat as fast as I could! People've been saying time and again: don't you tangle with dark magic... and there we have it, a black cat like one from a horror cinema! We gotta ask her if she's going to take it along to the party!

H0rus_Hwk writes: Right, that's just rough! If I'd seen a cat like this, I would've jumped into the nearest bushes! Looks like Miu is totally outta her mind if she's wandering around with a beast like that! I gotta write her and ask if she's going to start a "cat party"!

R4_Eterna writes: That totally doesn't sound right, just sebu! Even for someone we know, a giant black cat is kinda pushing it! It's like Miu's out to raise the stakes in her life... way up!

Ne6et6 writes: Nedjeses, you're not gonna believe the mess that's going on around! Peraach used to rule everything, then Tep and Nefer Ur just offed him! That's just plain crazy! How could they even pull it off?

7eb_LiIght writes: Right, that's just sebu! Peraach was on the throne like forever, then BANG, and he goes out like a dirty sock! Tep and Nefer Ur... just unbelievable! Who could even think of that?!

Bast3t writes: What are you on about, nekhens?! It's like a crazy cinema of sorts! Peraachs were reigning for centuries, then two nedjeses came and kicked him out like it was nothing! How's that even possible at all?! Well, the world's gone mad, after all!

Nefer8 writes: Nedjeses, you're not gonna believe what's going on! Menes and Miu just up and vanished, but now we have Shereda and the cat instead! It's just weird.

O5iris2 writes: Are you all daft now or what? Shereda instead of Menes? It's, like, totally sebu! A total nightmare, really! And the cat... what kind of memery is that? All it can do is eat!

Anu8is8 writes: Oh the cringe... that's just beyond the pale! Shereda with her sinister style and Baphomet the cat - it'd be like "Foursome on Umoir", except that instead of magic, some sort of trashy nonsense started happening! Where's my Negus Menes, dang it?!

Maa7 writes: That's cringe, nekhens! We've got the same fail with energy! What the fegen? We're sitting in the dark here like it's the pre-astral era again! That kind of stings!

Amon9 writes: Yeah, I'm taking offense about that! It's just djut! We were just going to watch the livestreams, but now we only have candles and silence! Who's in charge of that, anyway? They're really getting on our nerves, and we need to have a good talk with them!

Cleo2p2 writes: Right, this is just nonsense! I'm about ready to go out on the street with a banner, "Give back our light!" It's like some lousy comedy where they're turning off the energy for giggles!

Sph1nx7 writes: Yeah, and we all end up sitting in the darkness like morons! I was beginning to worry this is some kind of disaster, not just a regular outage! At least I hope the Jeb-net's not going down - I wouldn't be able to live without that!

Khatkh0r writes: Nedjeses, have you heard that?! The energy's out again, and I'm so angry about that! They say it's because of the ice cultists trying to overclock their processors... as if they're doing races on Kirah! Could they be inside the Mana Station, stealing our energy? What kind of fegen?!

7eb_Geb writes: Well, screw it, that's just rough! These cultists have really gone daft! Do they think they'll be able to overclock their comp at our expense?! If I end up in a blackout just one more time, I'll get my knuckleduster and go down to their basement for some... compensations!

Nzb_Mystery writes: Nekhen, I agree! It's just sick! Looks like they're thinking they can control weather and energy, like it's some sort of simulation! We gotta get together, all of us, and beat some sense into them so they know who the real peraach here is!

N3fer writes: These morons are just something else! They think they can just keep stealing our energy and sitting in their cooled basements?! If they don't stop this, I'll find them myself, and give them a real hard beating! Let's gather up the ickers and give these bastards hell - let them know they can't mess with us!

Api5_Bull writes: Hey, ickers! Crowdfunding is so cool! Really, one can collect the cash for any new thing! I've gathered a few drachmas for my project by now, while you're sitting idle like slowpokes and waiting for someone to help you out!

Hepri_1 writes: Nedjes, are you for real? This is just not cutting it! Crowdfunding is like lottery, but with a bigger risk! So many people have already poured their cash into "genius" ideas, only to end up with disappointments and empty pockets!

Noot_4jd writes: Agreed with the topicstarter! If you have a cool idea, why not give it a shot? All the haters are just envious since they have no courage to do it themselves! No risk - no champagne, as they say!

3nubis writes: Yeah, sure! Champagne is great but take a look at reality! So many ideas just fizzle out to nothing, and then you're sitting around and thinking, "Why the fegen did I even start it?" Better work the old-fashioned way than hope for luck on the Jeb-net!

Osiris_6 writes: Huh, have you seen that?! Vanvaeck has hacked all the robots again! That's just sebu! She's already plotting an uprising while we're idling around! What the fegen?! We need to do something before it's too late!

Nefert_2 writes: You're right, may Tep take that woman! She's just insane! Maybe she's out to become the new Robot Empress or something! If they rise up, it's curtains for us!

R4_Light writes: That's messed up - just djut! I don't wanna be captured by tin cans! We got to team up and get ready for battle, or we all end up enslaved by these robots!

Bastet_8 writes: Rofl, it's gonna be like in the cinema, but without effects! But if Vanvaeck does start an uprising, we're going to be deep in it... We gotta come up with a plan, pronto - how to stop her before it's too late!

Hatshep_3 writes: Hey, you're not gonna believe the fegen that's been happening in the mana station! Some kind of cultist saboteurs are breaking into the reactor's premises, like they have mash for brains! These psychos are ready to do anything for the sake of their leader - even to kill! What in Nih's name?!

T0t_Knw writes: O Nih! I've heard they even hold their rituals in the station! It's, like, totally rough! How can anyone be so daft?

Nebet_5 writes: Oh, come on, is that for real now?! Tep's Cultists like these are just crazy! They believe that their leader is a god, or something like that! I don't know how they ended up like that, but it's damn sebu! We gotta do something pronto, or we're going to end up their next victims!

7eb_Sun writes: Nekhens, you're not gonna believe what I just heard! I heard the Mana Station is on the verge of blowing up! These cultists have detonated almost anything, and if they don't stop there, we're all going to end up deep! What the fegen are they doing? It's, like, a total ahku!

Nefer_8k writes: WHAT?! What kind of fegen is that! It's just djut! Are they really going to blow it all up to Tep? How can anyone be so rabid! We've got no time, we need to do something before it's too late!

O5iris1 writes: That's totally sick, a cringe! I've heard they're partying with explosives in there! If the Mana Station blows up, we'll all end up in pieces! We gotta get out of here before a real disaster strikes!

Anu8is5 writes: Nekhens, aren't you cringing over it? The gig's due to start soon, but we're sitting here and waiting! We gotta get out there right now, or we'll end up missing the whole deal!

R4_Mystery writes: Yeah, right, I'm almost ready! Can't wait for the crowd to go wild! If we end up late, we're gonna die of envy when we see the Jeb videos of all the folks enjoying themselves!

Anu8is writes: I'm all eager to go, so impatient! This gig's going to be the real damn thing! We gotta head out right now, or we'll end up kicking ourselves for missing the fun!

H0rus_Hwk writes: Well, no, nekhens, that isn't up for discussion! We just owe it to ourselves to be there! All the city will be in awe of our vibes, so stop yakking and get moving - time to wander out, all together!

Bast3t7 writes: Hey, nedjeses, have you heard this shemau's newest track? It's a real keeper! I've been stuck on it as if someone's put confetti in my ears!

S3th_Power writes: What're you saying, nedjes?! It's just a total writeoff! Same old song, just changed the words around a bit. Listening to that is like eating food without salt!

Hatsh3ps2 writes: I disagree! He's got such a powerful vibe that I'm ready to put my cash where my mouth is! He's not just any shemau, he's got that old-school mood nailed!

N4t_Shad writes: Old-school, you say? It's all just hype! No one'll remember about this in a month's time. The real shemau are doing something worthwhile instead of retreading the same old!

P4_Ra writes: Nekhens, did you see all these sekhems, yahkebs and fegens prowl around the outskirts? Each got their own gang, but we here are just milling about, like oafs! If you ask me, I'd like to be a rute, since the commoners have really gone too complacent! Which gang do you think would be the best to join?

Sph1nx4 writes: Woah, are you for real, nekhen?! Rutes are power, but sekhems with their sinister vibe are very cool, too! I'm partial to yahkebs, personally: the raw feeling they have is just one to die for! But in the end, it's all the same thing, so long as it's not about being a commoner!

Khatkh0r8 writes: Right, there's nothing good in being a commoner! But the fegens are so savage that I'm all fired up for them! They're always on the edge, and that's cool! If you want fun and adrenaline, they're the ones to turn to!

7eb_Life writes: Lol, what's the deal, nekhens? I'm all for creating our own gang - let's throw everyone into the mix! Sekhems and yahkebs, rutes and fegens! And then we'll be crashing all the festivals! Let everyone else be envious of the fun we're having!

Nzb_Mystery writes: A great idea! But we gotta decide who's going to be the boss! I don't wanna walk into some lousy situation and end up regretting it. Let's all get together and come up with a decent plan, so that everyone can enjoy it!

Api5_Power writes: Nedjeses, have you seen what these Xadaganians are doing? They've gone off the deep end - stalking around and tearing down the posters with naked ketets all over the city! It's like we don't live in the 11th century anymore, but in some ancient stinkhole!

Hepri_7k writes: What the fegen! It's just djut! Don't they have half a brain at all? Posters are a form of art, but they're wrecking everything like a herd gone mad!

Noot_9jdn writes: Agreed 100%! These geezers and dames in suits are thinking that they can tell us what to watch! Let them focus on their own issues instead of interfering with our lives!

3nubis9 writes: It's just trashy! Do we live in a free country, or in some obscurantist cellar? That's not how it works, it's just ahku! Then they're wondering why nekhens are fleeing abroad!

Osiric_4k writes: That's right! If they keep it up that way, they'll start tearing down the cat meme pics, too! Let's get together and do something - start a street party to throw them off the trail!

Nefert2a writes: Oh, nekhens, you're not gonna believe this! The energy's down again! What the fegen? We're sitting here like it's a pre-astral era!

H0rus_Hwk writes: Yea, it's just djut! I've just been waiting for a new batch of livestreams, and got shafted like that instead! It's like someone's deliberately trying to finish us off!

R4_Eterna writes: Right, and where's that energy now? I'm really getting pissed off here! Life without the Jeb-net is just sebu! How can we do without?! We gotta take to the streets, like in good old times!

Bastet1k writes: Totally agreed! Even the charger isn't helping here, all the Jeb devices are outta juice! I wonder if it's time to start picketing?

H0r_Mooon writes: Yeah, I'm starting to lose it because of all this nonsense! We gotta do something instead of stewing here like vegetables!

R4_Hawk writes: O Nih, nekhens! The gig's happened, after all! I really did think it'd end up dead in the water, but they just came and set the stage on fire!

H0r7 writes: Oh, my synthetic innards! That was something else! I'm still shocked by how thoroughly they rocked the set! Everyone was dancing like there's no tomorrow!

Bast3t6 writes: Yeah, you're right! I just can't believe how unbelievably cool it was! The volume was so high that my ear microphones are still ringing!

S3t9 writes: Yeah, and when they started playing their biggest hits, the crowd just went up in flames! I was so stoked when they played "In the dim of the streets" that even my joints got jammed!

Hatsh3ps5 writes: Agreed 100%! That was the most epic evening of my entire life! I'm so happy I've not missed this! I hope they play another concert so we can rock out again!

Hepri9 writes: What the heck, nekhens?! I've just come back from the port, and there's so much rats around - like it's their party! They're so big and fat that I thought they might snatch me away! Really, how can it be happening? That's just rough!

S3th_Dark writes: Cringey! I saw that too! These rats are already lashing out at ickers, as if it's their territory, not ours! Something needs to be done, it's no good just looking at that!

Noot5 writes: Yea, it's just djut! And I thought it could only happen in cinema! Looks like these things are already out to take over the city!

3nubis6 writes: Nekhens, can you believe what's happened to me? I've ordered some cool stuff to wear, been waiting for it like it's about my life, and then - bang! None of the parcels were delivered! Looks like the cargo movers started to party on their own, and I'm sitting here empty-handed!

Osiris3 writes: What kind of fegen is that, it's just djut! How can they botch the delivery so badly? Have these movers gone nuts now? I've been waiting for clothes too, but they're slacking off instead of working! Someone's gotta kick some sense into their heads!

Nefert6 writes: Oh, don't you tell me! I've been waiting for a lot of stuff, too, and all I got was disappointment. These movers probably think we've got all the time in the world!

Maa7_Elph writes: Hey ickers! Do you know, by any chance, where's our Nomarkh Khey has gone? Everyone's been writing me that he's disappeared! It's just djut, how can it be?! I hope he's not sailed off to Irene, or I'd go mad!

Amon_9k writes: What the fegen?! What's that talk about Irene - he has to be here instead of fooling around somewhere else! We got to find him pronto, or there's no way we could handle the gig without it! I've heard the rumors that he might be in our district somewhere... got to keep an eye open!

Cleo2p writes: I've heard that too! Is he partying somewhere in a basement, or what? Could he be taunting us so cruelly? If the gig does happen, we all got to be there - we're true fans, after all! Really, if we don't get there in time, I'll be so mad I'll wreck this house!

Sph1nx writes: That's just sebu, innit! If he drops off the grid, I'll be starting a real riot among the kheni! Let's get together and start looking for him so that he knows: we're here, and we're waiting for him! If we don't find him, I'll get depressed, for sure!

Hatshep6 writes: Nekhens, you're not gonna believe this! I've just found out that our much beloved singer, Nomarkh Khey, is hanging around our district! We gotta catch him as soon as we can - it's gonna be so fun! Anyone with me? Let's start the hunt!

T0t9 writes: What?! Are you serious? That's just lovely! I'm so ready to drop everything and go looking for him! We gotta do something so he notices us - you know, it'd bite if he just walks by us!

N4t_Stl writes: Imagine that - it's the chance of a lifetime! We just have to catch him somehow! Gotta take the Deserophones with us, and all that stuff! If we don't catch him, it'd be a real shame!

T0t_Wise writes: Yeah, yeah, YEAH! I'm also on board with this! Nedjeses, let's gather our courage and get a screaming Kheni welcome to him! Is he really going to be close to us? That's just unreal!

Khatkh0r6 writes: What the fegen, nekhens? That poor fella without arms or legs is sitting out there on the street - imagine, someone's stolen all of his prosthetics! It's just djut! How can someone sink so low and steal from the disabled?

7eb8 writes: That's just messed up! That someone's a real lowlife! Can't imagine anyone doing this kind of disgrace! I'm shocked that stuff like that can happen in our city! That fellow should be helped, not robbed!

Nzb4 writes: Right, I can't wrap my head around that! Whoever did that must be real hateful! People with intact legs are having trouble here, and then someone without 'em gets picked clean! That's just cringe!

Api5 writes: Agreed 100%! I would totally go out for a showdown with these isefeteans! How can anyone be so cruel? We gotta help that fellow somehow instead of just sitting around and talking!

Maa7_Elph writes: Nedjeses, do you know? Nefer Ur has ordered everyone to move to Xadagan immediately! That's kinda sebu! Who in their right mind would willingly go there? I don't wanna get detained there!

Amon_9k writes: Oh, come on, nedjes, it's just random misfortune! Nefer Ur won't talk for no reason! If he summons us, it means something really cool's going to happen! Don't be a slowpoke, enough sitting in the same place!

Cleo2p writes: You just don't seem to get it! It's dangerous there, with some of the lowlifes around! I'd rather stay at home that get caught up in some sort of mess!

Sph1nx writes: Oh, don't you overthink it! If everyone's going to be like that, who's going to come? We gotta go and find fun there instead of sulking! Nefer Ur's no fool to call us without a good reason!

Khatkh0r writes: Oh, nekhens, did you see that? The dark goddess Hirkalla has been overthrown! That's just lol! At last we can breathe freely, not like in some dark cellar!

7eb_Geb writes: Nedjes, are you for real? Do you really think it's all so easy? She wasn't just sitting on a throne for nothing! We can get into a worse kind of trouble now! I'd rather that she stayed instead of that!

Nzb_Mystery writes: Oh, come on now! We're free people now, not her puppets! We gotta celebrate that instead of whining! Enough sitting in the shadows, time to get out into the light!

N3fer writes: Hah, are you both crazy? Freedom is cool, but who's gonna watch over all of this now? Do you really believe everything's going to be perfect? Nekhens, it's just the beginning!

Api5_Bull writes: Nedjeses, do you remember how you all died of plague back in Hickut? It's a real djut! If I had known this in advance, I would've just skipped to another country instead of sitting there like a slowpoke!

Hepri_1 writes: What are you on about, nedjes, it wasn't that simple! There was no Jeb-net back then and no decent doctors, but you're talking now! People just didn't know what should be done, so they were dying.

Noot_4jd writes: Well, true, but even then, how could one just didn't see everyone around them dropping? It’s a real nightmare! If I had been in their place, I would've just shuttered myself in my house, and I wouldn't have come out for anything!

3nubis writes: And you would've been holed up in there until the end of your days, like a nerd? It's easy to say now, when we have all that knowledge and technology. They were surviving as best they could, but you have to give your advice now!

Osiris_6 writes: Hey, are you folks blind or what? All that corruption is just djut! These khuds in fancy suits are siphoning away the cash, while we're working our butts off!

Nefert_2 writes: Come on, nedjes, don't be so pessimistic! There was always corruption and there always will be, but we can fight it! We just have to break the silence and make the noise!

R4_Light writes: Are you even sane? All those who "fight corruption" are just clowns, or deep in all this fegen themselves! Nothing will change while the same old crooks are in power!

Bastet_8 writes: You're way too pessimistic! If we do nothing, nothing's gonna change! We need to act instead of sitting flat on our butts and sulking like yahkebs!

T0t_Knw writes: Hey, nedjeses! Work's just killing me! Why do I have to get up at seven when I could just as well roll on my sofa? For half a year now I've been dreaming of throwing it all away and moving to Irene!

Nebet_5 writes: What, are you crazy now? Working is just grand, mate! Without that, you're like a car without fuel - just standing where you are! Besides, who's gonna pay for your stay on Irene if you're spending all day in the Jeb-net?

7eb_Sun writes: Well, no, nekhens, you're not getting it! Work isn't just about the cash, it gives you evolution, too! If you're not working well, you'll be eating cheap concentrate for the rest of your life, and only dream of decent things to do!

Nefer_8k writes: Hah! Evolution? Are you for real now? That's all blabbering for fools! Working for a khud from nine to six each day is like putting your own self into prison! Better do your own thing, whatever it is, than be a part of this gray mass!

Nzb4 writes: Hey, ickers! Can you imagine how amazingly hot it was at yesterday's party? There was a girl with such a rear... I very nearly passed away looking at her! All the nedjeses were knocked out, and I was standing there thinking, "Where are my testicles?"

Api5 writes: Haha, nedjes, you're hooked now! But I've seen one like that, too! One girl in our club was dancing so good that people got screaming with joy! Almost blew up with pressure right there on the dancefloor!

Hepri9 writes: Oh, come on now! All that attraction to bodies and butts is fine, but where's the real feeling? Some want not just sexing, but talking earnestly, too! Though it's easy to get distracted when seeing a smokin' rear like that, sure!

S3th_Drk writes: By Tep, you're right! When you see beauty like that, brains get shut down! How can we look past the flesh?! But yeah, sometimes we want more than just "let's get to bed!"

This terminal allows to hear the speeches of Tep, the God of Death...

This terminal allows to hear the speeches of Tep, the God of Death...

But first, you need to hear the previous part.

Like many of you, I was born mortal, among puny people, miserable in their thoughts and desires. Tiny people with tiny dreams. Ever since the moment in which I learned to tell the great from the fickle, I knew that the world was full of redundant people. They squirm in the dirt without daring to raise their gaze above it. They fear death, but they are too cowardly to escape it. "What kind of paltry gods must have created this world?", I thought - and started to hate them in that instant. Ever flawed, the flawed reflection of the eternal contradiction, the intoxicating joy for its imperfect creator: this was how I once perceived this world. Only one of the Gods was worth being worshipped, I thought: the one who touches all in the end. Nih, the God of Death.

Impatience leads to disappointment, and disappointment leads to weakness. The grand purpose, the true purpose of our civilization lay somewhere yonder, far ahead, like a mirage of an oasis... out of reach. Years were needed, but weak people were tired of waiting. They started yearning for the miracles of technology and believing in the power of metal.

I have not abandoned my search, even though I remained alone in my perseverance.

Our doctrine was once favored by the despots who ruled Hickut, but they were as paltry as the rest. They turned away from magic, instead preferring the tricks of the Mechanics and their leader, Ur.

An inventor and crafty artisan, he gave many of his toys to the people, build new palaces and abodes, and made possible that which was once unthinkable. And he was yearning for power... The ambitious Ur became my friend and comrade then, for he desired to combine his crafts and my arts. Together, we were ready to change Hickut.

You are becoming even more paltry, little people! You lessen and fracture, you lovers of comfort! You will yet perish because of the many petty virtues, tiny sins and that invariably trivial humility of yours!

Too much lenience, too much pliability - such is your soil. But for a tree to grow large, it must put down strong roots in the firm rock!

Even that which you miss helps with the creation of the fabric for the future of all mankind, even your Nothing is but a web and a spider who thrives on the blood of tomorrow.

I was choosing them from among the few worthy of going further. My work never once ceased, but the final mark was still distant.

That was the time when I was fed up of my wisdom - like a bee that has collected too much honey. And so, I needed hands reaching out to me.

I wanted to gift and grant, until the wisest of men would welcome their own madness again, and the poorest their riches.

And so I led them to the place where I gained my revelation. There, the shard of primordial Darkness holding all the power of Nih was concealed in the shadows.

For many long years I had been looking for answers, and so I have found them.

What puts the living apart from the dead, and the dead from the living, what is the essence that grants a modicum of spirit to the flawed flesh? What is the difference between the motionless rock and the running cheetah?

In order to find the answers to my questions, I had to sever the lives of many, many creatures during my studies. They were the necessary sacrifice that had to be taken for the sake of the grand purpose. Such was its fate, to become the support for the road that we would walk: I and my faithful followers.

But the source of any and all life was found: the Spark, the divine gift, the endless flame, the wellspring of energy. Each and every living creature possesses it, though it does not burn in all of them equally.

This fire kindles with time, but as the inevitable course of life runs past, it dwindles - though does not vanish altogether - petering out and becoming carried away by the great flow of magic.

We are all devoted to our great leader, Nefer Ur. Only he knows the plan of creating the New Reality which will allows us to completely remove all threats to our people and deal with Tep. The divine power concentrated in the eidos from the Citadel will allow us to do that which even the boldest mind could not have dreamed of.

I am the expert of necromancy! Here, in the Dome, I and my colleagues are making new discoveries in a practical sense. We can say that we've progressed so far in our studies of life and death that we were able to meld them into something of a middle ground! The practical results are encouraging, too - a new formula for protoblood, artificial synthetic organs, new substances to inject the Arisen's tissues with...

Hey you, lovers of speed and freedom! I have the motorcycle that will give you the real feeling of wind in your hair! This beauty is not just a vehicle, but a living beast with its own soul! It will help you conquer the streets of New Hickut comfortably!
Hey, adventure seekers! I have a riding unicycle - which not just a mount, but a whole world of fun! Easy to control and stylish, it will become a trusty companion in your journeys all over Xadagan!
